name: infranodus-plugins
description: InfraNodus plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build: InfraNodus Graph Memory (memory stored as a knowledge graph in your InfraNodus account, with GraphRAG recall), and the /infranodus skill. Both use your InfraNodus connector. Each plugin lives in its own repository; this catalog only points at them. The skills have their own marketplace, infranodus/skills.

plugins.name: infranodus-memory
plugins.description: InfraNodus Graph Memory: memory for coding agents, stored as a knowledge graph in your InfraNodus account. Works with your InfraNodus connector: recall is GraphRAG (it follows the graph's links by hop distance instead of matching text), and the memory can be saved to and optimized on request. An optional API key turns on automatic memory, which uploads what each session learned about the project and recalls it at the first prompt of the next one. Commands: /infranodus-memory:{status,save,remember,recall,optimize,forget-last,off,on}.

plugins.name: infranodus
plugins.description: [Also in infranodus/skills] Requires the InfraNodus connector. Knowledge graph + gap finder for your notes, vault, repo or agent memory: topic clusters, content gaps, research questions, GraphRAG retrieval, SEO/GEO. Skip it if you already have infranodus@infranodus-skills.
